headline: Patient Care Coordinator
summary: Caregiver of five years, three of them in a Davao residential care home, now coordinating patient care at a hospital in Surigao del Sur. I schedule and coordinate patients' care, take vital signs and assess basic needs, write care notes and respond with BLS in emergencies. My caregiving years help me see what patients and families need beyond the treatment.

projects.name: Discharge follow-up calls
bullets: Set up follow-up calls two days after discharge for elderly patients.
Caught several missed medicines and early warning signs and arranged earlier check-ups.

projects.name: Family caregiver sessions
projects.description: Taught monthly home-care sessions for families caring for bedridden relatives in Bislig.

skills: Basic patient assessment and vital signs
Clear English with patients and families

experience.title: Patient Care Coordinator
bullets: Schedule admissions, procedures and follow-ups for the medical ward and coordinate with each department.
Take vital signs and check patients' basic needs on rounds with the nurses.
Write care coordination notes and hand-over summaries.

experience.title: Caregiver
bullets: Cared for six elderly residents on my shift, including two living with dementia.
Assisted with medicines, bathing, meals and physiotherapy exercises.
Kept a daily care log for the family and visiting nurse.

experience.title: Caregiver
bullets: Looked after bedridden and post-stroke clients in their homes.
Reported changes in clients' condition to their families and doctors.
